subject: Enterprise onboarding: identity & network controls for Novatech
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha@novatech.com>
To: dev.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novatech.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Enterprise onboarding: identity & network controls for Novatech

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. We're ready to get started with Redwood on Monday (2/23) but want to align on the enterprise controls before the kickoff. Below are the primary items our security and infra teams have asked about: 

- SSO/SAML: SP metadata endpoint, ACS URLs, certificate exchange cadence, recommended assertion settings (NameID format, attributes).
- SCIM: provisioning scope, required SCIM attributes, whether Redwood supports group provisioning and delta updates.
- IP allowlist: public egress ranges we should allow outbound to (for webhook callbacks and admin console).
- Service accounts: recommended naming, rotation policy, and least-privilege scopes for SCIM API.
- Org policies: session timeout, admin roles, and audit log retention.

I've attached our IdP metadata (Novatech_IDP_metadata.xml) and a copy of our firewall team's baseline. Can you send a short internal plan (who from Redwood will own which pieces), a timeline for configuration, and any templates we should fill out before the kickoff?

Also copying Alex from our infra team who will coordinate firewall/IP questions.

Appreciate it — want to make sure the kickoff is setup to run smoothly.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Head of IT, Novatech
Samantha.Lowe@novatech.com

Attachment: Novatech_IDP_metadata.xml (application/xml)
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@novatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise onboarding: identity & network controls for Novatech

Hi Samantha — thanks for the detail and the metadata. Looping in Marissa (onsite implementation engineer) and Monica (CSM) so we have coverage for configuration, rollout, and account-level questions.

High-level plan (high level, 3 working-day sprint):
1) Pre-kickoff (by 2/22): Redwood to review IdP metadata, provide SP metadata URL, and share SCIM templates.
2) Kickoff (2/23): 45-minute session to confirm assertion mappings, SCIM attributes, service account creation, and firewall openings.
3) Configuration window (2/24–2/25): Marissa applies SAML config in a staging tenant; Monica coordinates SCIM test provisioning with your HR/test users.
4) Validation (2/25–2/26): Full provisioning test, login/SSO verification, and audit log sampling.

Immediate asks for you (so we can be ready at kickoff):
- Confirm preferred NameID (email vs. persistent) and any required attributes (employeeID, department).
- Provide a SCIM admin account with write scope for /Users and /Groups (we'll use a short-lived token for staging).
- Confirm the public IP ranges your egress will permit to our endpoints or, if you prefer, we can provide a set of static IPs for allowlisting.

SP/SCIM artifacts attached: Redwood_Implementation_Checklist.pdf (short checklist we ask customers to complete) and Redwood_ServiceAccount_Template.txt (example service account name and permission set).

Notes on controls:
- Certificates: we recommend active rotation every 12 months; we can support automated metadata exchange if your IdP supports it.
- SCIM: group provisioning supported; we recommend starting with users only and adding groups after initial validation. Delta patching is supported; we will provide attribute mappings during kickoff.
- IPs/Ports: Our services are reachable over HTTPS (443); we prefer allowlisting a small set of egress IPs — I'll include those in a follow-up once we confirm region.

Proposed kickoff time: 2/23 at 10:00 PT. Does that work? If yes I will send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Novatech live.

—Dev Patel
Enterprise Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Implementation_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_ServiceAccount_Template.txt (text/plain)
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@novatech.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Samantha Lowe <samantha@novatech.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise onboarding: identity & network controls for Novatech

Thanks Dev — 10am PT on 2/23 works. A couple quick infra clarifications from our side: 

- Firewall rules: We only allow outbound to specific IP ranges and only on ports 443 and 22 for a small set of maintenance hosts. Will Redwood require SSH (22) for any part of onboarding? If not, we will not open it.
- IP allowlist granularity: Can you provide a list of CIDRs for both production and staging endpoints? We try to minimize wide ranges.
- SCIM: The admin account we plan to hand you will have full user and group write permissions in staging. For production, we will prefer scoped service accounts.

Forwarding Novatech_Firewall_Config.pdf for reference.

Alex Ruiz
Infrastructure Lead, Novatech
alex.ruiz@novatech.com

Attachment: Novatech_Firewall_Config.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Samantha/Alex — following up with concrete artifacts and the kickoff invite. Apologies for the brief delay; we validated the staging endpoints and SCIM token flow.

1) IP allowlist (staging / prod):
- staging: 54.201.12.34/32, 54.201.12.35/32
- prod: 34.227.198.101/32, 34.227.198.102/32
Please allow HTTPS (443) outbound to these addresses. We do not require SSH (22) for onboarding.

2) SAML/SP endpoints:
- SP entity ID: https://redwood.com/saml/novatech
- ACS URL: https://redwood.com/saml/acs/novatech
- Metadata (SP): https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1a2B3cRedwoodSPMeta

3) SCIM/service account guidance:
- Use the attached ip_allowlist.txt as copyable CIDR entries.
- For staging send a short-lived token (valid 24h) with write:/Users and write:/Groups scope. For production we recommend a named service account: redwood-scim-novatech@novatech-svc with token rotation every 90 days.

4) Audit & retention: We default to 90 days of admin audit logs; if you need longer retention we can enable 365-day retention under an enterprise add-on (we can discuss during renewal).

Kickoff: I've scheduled 2/23 10:00–10:45 PT and sent a calendar invite (link below). Agenda: introductions, confirm NameID and attribute map, SCIM attributes, service account creation, firewall checklist, and next steps.
